question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A book published after author’s death.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **"Posthumous publication".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A book published after author’s death** (मरणोपरांत प्रकाशित पुस्तक) - A publication released following the death of its author.
 
• **Posthumous publication** (मरणोपरांत प्रकाशन) - A work published after the author's death.
 
 
• **Example**: The poet's last collection of poems was a posthumous publication, revealing his enduring legacy.
 
 
 
• This option directly describes the act of publishing works after the author's demise.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Posthumous publication".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Posthuman publication **(पोस्टह्यूमन प्रकाशन) - A hypothetical term, not standard in this context.
 
• **Supernatural publication **(अलौकिक प्रकाशन) - Pertains to content that is beyond scientific understanding or the natural world.
 
• **Predecessor publication **(पूर्ववर्ती प्रकाशन) - Refers to works published prior by another author or before a certain edition.
